_readme: Batch from inbox/pending/07 26 group PDFs — 20 new books + mentions on 4 pre-existing (A Moveable Feast, Breakfast at Tiffany's, The Kite Runner, The Plague). Klara and the Sun excluded: PDF text extraction failed (only ~4000 chars recovered, insufficient to verify/synopsize). Synopses grounded in real detect.mjs-extracted text where mentions came from; genres assigned per tools/genres.mjs.

books.title: 1Q84
books.author: Haruki Murakami
books.synopsis: A woman assassin named Aomame and an aspiring novelist named Tengo find their fates converging after both notice small, unsettling changes to the world — two moons, a shadowy cult called Sakigake, and tiny beings known as the Little People — in a Tokyo that seems to have slipped into a parallel 1984.

books.title: A Fine Balance
books.author: Rohinton Mistry
books.synopsis: During India's State of Emergency, a widowed seamstress, a student boarder, and two tailors fleeing caste violence are thrown together in a cramped Bombay flat, their fragile friendship tested by a country turning against its poorest citizens.

books.title: Blood Meridian
books.author: Cormac McCarthy
books.synopsis: A teenage runaway falls in with a band of scalp-hunters roaming the Texas-Mexico borderlands, dominated by the monstrous, erudite Judge Holden, in a hallucinatory, blood-soaked reckoning with American violence.

books.title: Educated
books.author: Tara Westover
books.synopsis: Raised by survivalist parents in the Idaho mountains with no birth certificate and no schooling, Westover teaches herself enough to escape to college, and finds that education costs her the only family she's ever known.

books.title: Interpreter of Maladies
books.author: Jhumpa Lahiri
books.synopsis: Nine stories trace Indian and Indian-American lives adrift between two cultures — a tour guide who translates a doctor's symptoms and confessions alike, a couple grieving a stillborn child, a babysitter navigating a new country — in Lahiri's Pulitzer-winning debut collection.

books.title: Lonesome Dove
books.author: Larry McMurtry
books.synopsis: Two aging ex-Texas Rangers drive a stolen herd of cattle from the Rio Grande to Montana, the long trail claiming friends, lovers, and outlaws along the way in McMurtry's Pulitzer-winning epic of the fading American frontier.

books.title: Never Let Me Go
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.synopsis: Kathy, Ruth, and Tommy grow up together at Hailsham, an English boarding school whose true, chilling purpose as a breeding ground for organ donors only gradually reveals itself.

books.title: No Country for Old Men
books.author: Cormac McCarthy
books.synopsis: A Texas welder who stumbles on a drug deal gone wrong and its two million dollars in cash is hunted across the border country by an implacable killer, while an aging sheriff trails behind, increasingly certain the world has outrun him.

books.title: The Bluest Eye
books.author: Toni Morrison
books.synopsis: A poor Black girl in 1940s Ohio longs for blue eyes, believing they would make her beautiful and loved, in Morrison's unsparing debut novel about racism, self-hatred, and a shattered childhood.

books.title: The Buried Giant
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.synopsis: In a post-Arthurian Britain shrouded in a mist that erases memory, an elderly couple sets out to find the son they can no longer clearly remember, crossing paths with ogres, a dragon, and an aged Sir Gawain.

books.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
books.author: Stieg Larsson
books.synopsis: A disgraced financial journalist and a brilliant, damaged hacker investigate a wealthy family's decades-old disappearance, unearthing a trail of serial murder tied to Sweden's darkest secrets.

books.title: The Glass Castle
books.author: Jeannette Walls
books.synopsis: Walls recounts a nomadic childhood of poverty and neglect under her brilliant, alcoholic father and free-spirited mother, and her escape from their chaos to build a stable life in New York.

books.title: The Help
books.author: Kathryn Stockett
books.synopsis: In 1960s Jackson, Mississippi, a young white writer persuades Black maids to share their stories of working for white families, risking all their safety in the segregated South.

books.title: The Namesake
books.author: Jhumpa Lahiri
books.synopsis: Gogol Ganguli, son of Bengali immigrants in America, spends years chafing against the unwanted Russian name his father gave him, before he can understand the private tragedy behind it.

books.title: The Rebel
books.author: Albert Camus
books.synopsis: Camus traces the idea of rebellion from metaphysical revolt against God through revolutionary politics and terror, asking whether rebellion can be lived without collapsing into the very murder and tyranny it rises against.

books.title: The Remains of the Day
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.synopsis: An aging English butler drives across the countryside to see a former housekeeper he once loved, reflecting on a lifetime of loyal service to a lord whose Nazi sympathies he chose not to see.

books.title: The Time Traveler's Wife
books.author: Audrey Niffenegger
books.synopsis: Henry, a librarian with a genetic disorder that yanks him uncontrollably through time, and Clare, the artist who has loved him since childhood, piece together a marriage lived out of order.

books.title: The Unconsoled
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.synopsis: A celebrated pianist arrives in an unnamed Central European city for a concert he can't quite remember agreeing to, and finds his schedule, memory, and grip on reality dissolving into dreamlike distortion.

books.title: The Road
books.author: Cormac McCarthy
books.synopsis: A father and his young son push a shopping cart down an ash-covered highway toward the coast, scavenging to survive and hiding from cannibals in an America destroyed by an unnamed apocalypse.

books.title: When We Were Orphans
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.synopsis: A celebrated English detective returns to 1930s Shanghai to solve the central mystery of his own life: the long-ago disappearance of his parents.
